moments.visual_action: The world map appears as the company is introduced.
Routes spread across the map as a symbolic group of people holding phones assembles; the icons are not a measured count.
Connections reach different regions of the world.
The drawing changes to a handset moving into a pocket.
The handset continues into the pocket.
Several drawn phones assemble, representing many users rather than a measured count.
The name is visible as the illustrated phones resolve toward the central handset.
The Nokia market-share bar grows alongside rivals' shares on the same scale.
Nokia remains the tallest vendor bar in the 2008 comparison.
A year-labeled series begins to build.
The earliest and highest Nokia share remains legible.
The plotted path and later years make the decline visible.
Several touchscreen handsets fan out and their app screens build.
A touchscreen and keypad are compared.
The transition arrow draws from keypad toward touchscreen.
A touch indicator reaches the new screen, which opens an interface panel.
